response.overview: 'Curtains' is a dark comedy/drama about talent manager Jay and his seemingly insurmountable client, Nick Layton. For this out-of luck actor, it's all gotten too much: failed awards seasons and fuck P.A.s, cults and critical disdain, prompting him to put on the ultimate publicity stunt.  A suicidal stage show, one night only...  Jay is left with the task of talking his client out of this drastic move. Will he succeed, or will Nick, along with the first three rows, get blown to pieces?
response.title: Curtains
